stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Rodney Francis on 19 pts - leading the comp the way Penrith lead Septembers: on principle

stories.title: Running Hot
stories.detail: 3 straight 3-pointers on holes 5, 6 & 7

stories.title: The Big Gun
stories.detail: 4-pointer on hole 5

stories.title: Nailbiter
stories.detail: one point splits the top two - down to the wire

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 71 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: The Great Escape
stories.detail: Dennis Pollock on 14 pts - the blue balls had his name, then he took it back

stories.title: Relatively Good Golf
stories.detail: the Francis name is having a day - Rodney and Ian both up and about

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 1 off the pace

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 7, 8 & 9 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 7, 8 & 9 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Perfectly Mediocre
stories.detail: 3 1-pointers straight - one point at a time, every time

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: The Null Hypothesis
stories.detail: 5 twos on holes 5-9 - the scorecard is a flatline

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: The Grind
stories.detail: 3 1-pointers in a row on holes 7, 8 & 9

stories.title: Short Memory
stories.detail: 2 wipes, every one followed by a score - forgets fast

stories.title: Giveth and Taketh Away
stories.detail: 3-pointer straight into a 1-pointer on holes 8 & 9

stories.title: Rough Patch
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 7 & 8 - club still in the bag

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 5 & 6 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 6, 3-pointer on hole 7 - that's better

stories.title: Footy Form Guide
stories.detail: David Bussenschutt finished 13 pts at 1.4 a hole - the bar is the only trophy today
